rules: offer: "saltix-connect:1:" then six values joined by ":": relay node key, sid, Q (X25519), P (Ed25519), origin, name; base64url without padding; keys 32 bytes; origin and name UTF-8
link: "https://saltix.io/connect#" followed by the offer's text

origin: "https://" or "http://", a host of lowercase ASCII DNS labels (letters, digits, '-', none at a label's ends, no trailing dot) or an IPv6 address in brackets, and ":port" (no leading zero, not the scheme's default) when the page has one; 1 to 128 bytes
a wallet connects to https:// origins; a debug build also to http://localhost, http://127.0.0.1 and http://[::1] with any port
ConnectLogin: Borsh {network [32] (genesis hash), account [32], origin String (u32 length + UTF-8), sid [32], page [32] (P), at u64 (Unix ms)}
message = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix connect login v1", Borsh(ConnectLogin)); an Ed25519 signer signs the 32 bytes (strict verification), a P-256 signer signs SHA-256 of them as r ‖ s with s ≤ n/2
ConnectGrant: Borsh {version u8 = 1, login, signer DeviceKey (tag 0 Ed25519 [32], tag 1 P256 [33] compressed), signature [64]}
ConnectSeen: Borsh {tag u8 = 0, at u64}; a payload's first byte tells them apart: 0 seen, 1 grant, anything else refused; one value, nothing after it

payload: base64url of E ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce = 24 zero bytes, aad = sid ‖ P), E = X25519(e, 9), S = X25519(e, Q), key = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix link payload v1", S ‖ E ‖ Q); e = one_time_secret

the page takes a grant when: version 1; network, origin, sid and page are its session's; |at − now| ≤ 600000 ms; the signature verifies under signer; and by the account's key event log (account_log): an empty log and an Ed25519 signer whose personal id (BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix address v1", [0] ‖ key)) is the account, or a log that checks offline from its origin (13-accounts §7) whose controller lists the signer as a device that is not a guardian
the address shown: kind 0 for an empty log or a log whose origin is a key (an upgraded account), kind 5 for a log whose origin is a root

logs: "none" (empty), "managed" and "managed-without-phone" (accounts-v1.json's managed account), "managed-payments" (the same account's phone added by the root, then a BuyWork registry call signed by the root and the phone and a transfer signed by the root alone: events because the root signed, whose actions a page may pass over), "upgraded" (accounts-v1.json's upgrade as its account's first event, slot 50)
